flags.message: Amicus counter appears to undercount on this docket: the frozen contexts and the outcome both record amicus_briefs = 6, while the 2026-08-16 snapshot carries 13 amicus docket entries; two candidates independently attributed the gap to the counter matching 'Brief amicus curiae' (singular) but not 'Brief amici curiae' (plural) captions. The interim-v1 amicus-increment claim therefore resolved on counter semantics rather than on filings (codex-baseline staked 0.99 on the recorded count rising past 6, and it stayed at 6). Worth a look at the amicus parser before the next interim scoring pass.
